text:
lina-partners: Heads up — GreenCloud (marketplace partner) reports provisioning webhook errors; multiple customers see 502s when activating listings. Reached out to their SEV channel at 09:02 PT with no reply yet. Suggest we spin a shared war room and agree an escalation path.

sam-eng: Can you paste the error lines? Need to know if it's our webhook or upstream.

lina-partners: Quick snippet from our proxy logs: `callback_id=abc123 status=502 upstream_timeout service=marketplace/v1/provision`

maria-sre: :rotating_light: I'll take incident lead. Recommend we create #partners-greencloud-sev and follow the partner-sev-ops playbook. I'll create the war room now.

oncall-bot: War room created: https://redwood.warrooms/1779001234
Participants: @maria-sre, @lina-partners, @sam-eng, @devon-support

devon-support: I'll open a support ticket with GreenCloud and DM their PM. Also will request logs export and a point-of-contact for live pairing. Meanwhile, eng: confirm logs retention/export for the callback_id.

sam-eng: Confirmed, logs available. Quick triage command: ```grep 'callback_id=abc123' /var/log/redwood/proxy.log | tail -n 50```

aaron-sales: Heads up — 3 paid customers impacted. Need an immediate customer status comms. @lina-partners can you coordinate a joint status email to affected accounts?

lina-partners: Yep. Draft status: "We're actively investigating a provisioning error affecting GreenCloud marketplace listings. Action is in progress; next update in 30 minutes." Thoughts?

maria-sre: Escalation matrix (decision we should formalize):
1) Shared Slack channel for realtime discussion (#partners-greencloud-sev)
2) War room with roles: Incident Lead + Partner Liaison + Eng Triage + Support Lead
3) If no resolution within 30m or customer-impact grows, trigger paging policy: call partner SE + partner exec oncall + open customer bridge
Contacts (for this partner): Partner SE: greencloud-se@vendor.com; Partner PM: emily.p@greencloud.com; Exec: tom.green@greencloud.com

sam-eng: Also proposing an automated fallback: route provisioning calls to region-b if upstream times out. I'll open a PR with a temporary toggle flag.

maria-sre: :thumbsup: Good. Runbook snippet I'll pin in the war room for quick reference:
```
# war room creation
/create-channel partners-greencloud-sev
/pin https://redwood.runbooks/partners/greencloud
# roles
- Incident lead: @maria-sre
- Partner liaison: @lina-partners
- Eng triage: @sam-eng
- Support lead: @devon-support
# escalation timings
- T0: create war room + initial triage
- T+15m: update customers, attempt partner SE contact
- T+30m: escalate to paging (call + exec loop)
```

oncall-bot: Pager: page sent to @maria-sre (oncall) at 09:07 PT

devon-support: Partner replied — they see spikes on their ingress NLB and are restarting webhook workers. They're pairing with our eng now. I'll post updates in the war room.

lina-partners: :wave: Thanks all. After this stabilizes let's capture the SLA handoff doc: who pages, who owns customer comms, and what channels are canonical.

aaron-sales: :thumbsup: Agreed. Also propose a 30min retrospective with GreenCloud tomorrow morning to tighten the flow and update the runbook.

maria-sre: Will own the retrospective invite and the PR that adds this partner-specific escalation matrix to the partners runbook. Closing loop here when partner confirms recovery.
